newsitem.title: GERMANY: Reuters launches risk management product.
newsitem.headline: Reuters launches risk management product.

text.p: International news and information group Reuters Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it was launching a new product for risk and performance analysis in continental Europe.

The Risk Manager product is a computer application designed to help financial institutions manage risk throughout their organisations, the head of risk management products at Reuters, Robert Jeanbart, told a briefing in Frankfurt.

The product is to be launched first in Germany, where Reuters has been most active in risk management. Wider availability across all major European centres is due over the next few months, the company said.
